title: 修复抽取多人时撒花卡顿问题
body:
This pull request optimizes the animation effect handling in the lottery card selection logic. Instead of adding the "prize" effect to each card individually during their animation, the effect is now applied collectively after all animations complete, reducing performance issues and improving user experience.

Animation effect optimization:

* Moved the addition of the `"prize"` class from inside the card animation loop to a single operation after all card animations finish, preventing multiple triggers and potential UI lag. (`product/src/lottery/index.js`, [[1]](diffhunk://#diff-6a803c175085f4a13de1dfbe20d84429840af854cdf736fb3d9ce79bf006cc1aL544) [[2]](diffhunk://#diff-6a803c175085f4a13de1dfbe20d84429840af854cdf736fb3d9ce79bf006cc1aL553-R555)
